top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is the most mature and best-evidenced achievement on the slate: a designed molecule forms a ternary complex whose cooperativity and geometry decide ubiquitination, turning occupancy-driven into event-driven pharmacology, confirmed independently for two decades. Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated it; Ciulli made it a general, structure-guided design method (VHL ligands, all-small-molecule degraders, ternary-complex structures), which gives a coherent citation scoped to designed degraders. P002 follows because it is the same topic with Handa for the glue lineage; P003 and P004 split the prize with base editing (and C-N coupling), which dilutes or drops the strongest case; no award is last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile (Lund colleagues Linke and Somfai sit on the committee, but no link to any proposed laureate)
